analysis.reason: RSI 41.5로 과매도 구간 탈출 시도, MACD 히스토그램 개선세 확인. 그러나 SMA200 하회(-1.33%) 및 SMA50(-20.70%) 하회로 중장기 이평선 하방 압력 지속. ADX 29.0으로 추세 강도는 유지되나, -DI(35.3)가 +DI(21.0) 상회하며 하락 압력 우위. 5일 연속 음봉 마감 후 반등 시도이나 거래량 위축(0.71배)으로 신뢰도 하락. 52주 위치 44.4%로 박스권 하단부 위치. 매수 진입은 SMA200 회복 및 거래량 동반 확인 필요. 매도 진입은 스윙 지지선 29,075원 하회 확인 필요.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI attempts to exit oversold at 41.5, MACD histogram shows improvement. However, downward pressure from mid-to-long term moving averages persists with price below SMA200 (-1.33%) and SMA50 (-20.70%). ADX at 29.0 indicates strong trend, but -DI (35.3) is above +DI (21.0), showing downward pressure dominance. Trading volume is subdued at 0.71x the 5-day average, reducing conviction in the attempted rebound after 5 consecutive down days. Current position at 44.4% of 52-week range, near the lower bound. A buy entry requires reclaiming SMA200 with accompanying volume. A sell entry needs confirmation of breaking the swing support at 29,075.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (31,435 KRW) vs SMA5 (32,771 KRW)/SMA20 (34,979 KRW)/SMA50 (43,860 KRW) — below short-to-mid term trends, confirming weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100 (40,976 KRW)/SMA200 (31,858 KRW) — below mid-to-long term trends, confirming weak strength.
· 52-week position (44.4%) + approaching historical low range at current price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (29.4→41.5) + attempting to exit oversold, weakening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1024.9154→223.3258) + improving, potential for bearish reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band at 26,832 KRW) + band width at 46.58% indicates a period of expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at 29,075 KRW + based on Pivot S1 (23,295 KRW).
· Swing resistance at 35,220 KRW + potential for short-term rebound upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (potential Higher Low formation) + possibility of recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.71x) + reduced conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + condition to wait and see, confirming SMA200 reclaim and accompanying volume.
